_comment: The Liscor gate district street content, now reached the ONLY way there is post-onboarding -- the real cold-start arc. Prologue reuses combat_walkthrough's proven part-1 (classless spar) + sleep (Warrior L1) + part-2 (proximity ambush, warrior+Relc) to arrive at street (1,3); the old goblin_parley 'Stand aside' bypass is dead (the ambush is corridor-free, so there is no combat-free crossing anymore). Then the street half proper: the music_street + 640/106 map payload, the y4 transit lane with the market/Guild detours, krshia_stall/sewer_grate exact toasts, the Watch gate_guard dialogue_line. Selys RELOCATED off the street into the Guild interior (guild_interior_walkthrough is now her canonical proof, pool line + graph + desk) -- this script no longer stops at her old (26,4) cell (row y4 is clear all the way through it now) and guild_door is a REAL DOOR, not a toast (the old toast-wait pin moved to a map_changed/ui_map_rendered transition assertion, disclosed in the DP1 report). Seed 9.

steps._comment: == PART 1: meet Relc, spar (classless) ==. (2,3) right12+1 -> inn_door (15,3) -> floodplains (7,6), right5->(12,6), down6->(12,12).
SOCIAL PILLAR II PHASE C: first talk to Relc this waking now absorbs the rotating pool line (dialogue_line + chatted_with_<id> + heard_gossip banks); a second interact opens the real conversation.

payload_contains.speaker: Relc
payload_contains.text: Ha! Good instinct. Everyone swings wrong until someone laughs at them. Watch keeps training dummies in the gatehouse; I drag a couple out when gate duty gets slow. Don't ask about the wheels. Rules are simple: you move, you hit, you don't cry.

steps._comment: == SLEEP -> Warrior L1 ==. (12,12) up6->(12,6), left5->(7,6), up+interact -> inn (14,3), left12->(2,3), down3->(2,6), down blocks on the bed, interact -> sleep.
== PART 2: cross the proximity ambush (warrior + Relc) ==. (2,6) up3->(2,3), right12+1 -> inn_door -> floodplains (7,6), right23->(30,6), down14->(30,20), down1 springs the ambush.
Roster POSITIVE: met_relc banked in part 1, so ally_requires fields Relc on the player side.
Attack targeting opens and cancels spending nothing -- ap stays 4.
steps.name: hotbar_1

steps._comment: The gate opens onto the street (post-victory the ambush is dormant, no re-trigger).
CARRIED MINOR (controller correction): this script now owns the street-music evidence combat_walkthrough dropped when its route left street for the floodplains.

D1-4: 32x20 payload computed from the shipped street block -- floor_cells = 32*20 = 640. blocked_cells is the SIM's runtime blocked set (Game.sim.blocked_cells), which is the static 'blocked' list (56 cells) UNION the wall 'segments' expansion (WIGame.segment_cells): [0,0]-[31,0] = 32 cells, [0,1]-[0,2] = 2 cells, [0,4]-[0,19] = 16 cells, none overlapping the interior 'blocked' list -- 56 + 32 + 2 + 16 = 106. Verified against the actual ui_map_rendered payload, not guessed from the static list alone.

Arrive at street (1,3). Down onto the y4 transit lane and bump gate_guard (1,5) -- a plain npc with no conversation graph, so interact fires dialogue_line directly (no dialogue_started/ui_dialogue_shown).

SOCIAL S4: gate_guard now carries a talk_pool, so the FIRST interact this waking plays its rotating pool line (idx 0, speaker still 'Watch Guard' display name) + banks chatted_with_gate_guard/heard_gossip. A second interact then yields the flavor dialogue[0] this beat asserts.

payload_contains.speaker: Watch Guard
payload_contains.text: Gate's clear. Keep it that way and we'll get on fine.

payload_contains.speaker: Watch Guard
payload_contains.text: Keep the gate clear. And if you're headed out, the road's got goblins on it lately. Watch knows. Watch is dealing with it.
Watch Guard: Keep the gate clear. And if you're headed out, the road's got goblins on it lately. Watch knows. Watch is dealing with it.

steps._comment: East along y4 to krshia_stall's column (14,2) -- bump north from (14,3), the stall entity blocks (14,2) so interact fires without ever standing on the counter.

payload_contains.text: Silverfang goods, honest prices. The Gnoll shopkeeper is off haggling elsewhere. A sign says she remembers faces, and debts.

steps._comment: Back onto y4, then south down the dirt side street (x15) to the south square and the sewer_grate POI (16,11).

payload_contains.text: A heavy iron grate, rusted shut. Cold air rises from below, and something in the dark skitters away from your shadow.

steps._comment: Re-path: back up to y4. Selys relocated off the street, so row y4 is now clear straight through her old (26,4) cell -- stop at (25,4) anyway (10, not 11, steps) to reuse the proven Guild-block detour below unchanged.
Detour around the Guild block's static-blocked (26,3) via the open y5 row, then up to the forecourt and bump guild_door (28,3) -- a REAL DOOR now, not a toast prop.

The old toast pin ("The Guild hall is packed with adventurers arguing over a bounty board. Selys handles the counter work outside today.") is RETIRED -- the door transitions for real now. Chronology matches guild_interior_walkthrough's proven order: map_changed fires synchronously inside transition(), world.gd's handler rebuilds (mood/map/entities) BEFORE control returns to record on_enter_accomplishment.
